result.notes: Skipped drinks, sauces, pita/bread and small side add-ons, the shared 'Menüs für Zwei' set menus (65-89 EUR), and the desserts. Dip platter is priced per 2 people (17 EUR), and the estimate covers the whole platter. Prices for items with sizes use the large size where noted. Estimates are rough, based on typical Berlin portions.

dishes.name: Dip-Platte (für 2 oder 3 Personen)
dishes.description: Baba-Ganoush, Matbucha, Rote Beete Dip, Labaneh Käse, Tahini serviert mit 3 bzw. 5 Pitas
dishes.portion_assumption: Whole platter for 2 people (17 EUR size) with 3 pitas
dishes.assumptions: About 500 g of mixed dips, 3 pitas at about 150 kcal each, and tahini and oil as served. The total is for the whole platter, so halve it for one person.

dishes.name: Suppe des Tages
dishes.description: Suppe des Tages (wechselnd)
dishes.portion_assumption: About 300 ml bowl
dishes.assumptions: The soup changes daily. Assumed a vegetable or legume soup with some oil.

dishes.name: Rote Beete Carpaccio

dishes.portion_assumption: About 150 g beets, 20 g walnuts, fried celery chips
dishes.assumptions: Assumed oil dressing, 20 g walnuts, pomegranate syrup, and fried celery chips.

dishes.name: Gebackener Blumenkohl mit Tahini
